class.description: Visualizes and edits a selected channel (`W` by default, or `X`/`Y`/`Z`) of a `Spline4DResource` over normalized cumulative section weights, with a live RGBA/HSVA color gradient strip at the bottom. Part of IdeamSplines (2D/3D Bezier/Catmull-Rom splines and scene-space spline editing).
